scope: Writer-first Bijay Mishra profile; research only

sources.title: I celebrate failures too, says thespian Bijay Mishra
sources.author: Bijay Mandal
claims: Mishra calls theatre his first love despite earnings and recognition from cinema.
Recalls observing people at railway stations and travelling general class while employed by government.
Recalls opening Sababahakamane with ten minutes of darkness, initially puzzling audience; attributed memory, not reconstructed scene.
Recalls learning screenplay writing from Shyamal Mukherjee during Jajabara.
Says he co-directed Jajabara with Hemanta Das and Akshaya Mohanty under Trimurty.
Names Sababahakamane, Duiti Suryadagdha Phulaku Nei and Tata Niranjana among preferred plays.
Describes examining failures to understand what went wrong.
sources.locators: Sections On getting the Jayadev Award; On setting a new trend; On making darkness a central character; On celebrating failures; On inspirations; On favourite plays and films
limits: Participant testimony; do not turn recollections into independently witnessed scenes.
Table lists plays and movies in separate columns, NOT adaptation pairs.
Do not reproduce dismissive2019industry generalisations as current facts.
Avoid unspecific total film/play counts.
